tools.name: libyan-legal-facets
tools.description: Get available filter options (document types, years, issuing authorities, legal subjects) with document counts for a specific collection. Use this to discover what filters are available before performing a search.

tools.name: libyan-legal-search
tools.description: Search the largest digital archive of Libyan legal documents. Supports legislation (20,000+), Supreme Court rulings, official gazette issues, international conventions, fatwas (legal opinions), and trademarks. Accepts Arabic and English queries. Returns paginated results with titles, dates, and document URLs.

query.description: Search query in Arabic or English (e.g. "قانون العمل" or "labor law")
